conditions.runtime_scope: Test JEM and the ordinary local server only

conditions.minerent_recruits: MaxRecruitsForPlayer = 30 is prepared for a later MineRENT server-only release and is not a managed-pack default

conditions.architecture_scope: The family and individual-home owner is modpack-level JEM Settlements on integrated and dedicated logical servers. Current distribution remains Test JEM and the ordinary local server.

change.summary: Refresh Test JEM mods, quests, shaders and menu scale, then add the universal JEM Settlements family and individual-home system

modifiers.notes: VanillaBackport 1.2.2 requires Platform [1.4,). Rotten Creatures accepts [1.2.4,).

modifiers.after: restored with real loaded client chunks and nearby loaded entities only

modifiers.before: native VillagerMakeLove plus one additional parent HOME cube admission

after.identity: persistent Jade-only international name, immutable sex, 5 percent same-sex orientation, spouse and parent relations
after.home: one bed-head anchored 3x3x3 zone from bed Y through Y+2 per person, with unique bed/chest/workstation and at least one light-emitting block; children do not require a workstation
after.family: permanent spouse after courtship, remarriage 1-10 Minecraft days after spouse death, close-kin exclusion and ordinary villager children from every fertile pair
after.presentation: Jade rows, 5-second complaint and 10-second quiet cycle, native trade and Recruits Home tabs, HousingInspector and native Xaero centering
after.villages: one-time top-up to 4-5 basic village guards at a persisted bell anchor
after.recipes: all six installed Recruits profession tables

modifiers.notes: JEM replaces VillagerMakeLove with one bounded family engine. Native Villager food and Recruits hunger/morale remain eligibility inputs. Missing home resources reduce happiness and block birth but do not block sleep. Spouse beds may be separate or adjacent.

modifiers.after: current retained shaders plus Derivative 26.3, with one original Complementary Unbound and native medium profiles

rationale.purpose: Apply the requested Test JEM content, presentation, quest-economy and modpack-level villager-family rules while keeping the recruit limit server-owned and preserving unrelated gameplay owners
rationale.decision_source: User-requested removals, additions, Inventory Tabs restoration, shader refresh, FTB Coin rewards, fixed main-menu scale, universal villager families and homes, category split, Sirok boundary increase and MineRENT-only recruit cap
rationale.implementation_choices: Use the same Distant Horizons JAR on client and server, add 15 blocks to each horizontal side of Sirok's native structure bounds, classify only items already owned by the Weapons tab, fund quest rewards from OPERATIONS, use one persisted JEM family owner across Villager and Recruits replacements, retain table-origin family capability through promotions, seed villages by persisted bell anchor, and update Platform to the current Forge release that satisfies VanillaBackport 1.2.2

introduced.summary: Implement the requested Test JEM pack and gameplay changes

history.summary: Remove the retired mods, add the approved replacements, update JEM integrations and record structure ownership
Restore loaded-chunk-only Inventory Tabs, update VanillaBackport ownership, add Tiny Takeover, refresh shaders, add funded quest Coins, fix title scale and add settlement breeding-home admission
Replace the narrow parent-home admission with persistent families, individual homes, Recruits integration, Jade and native Home UI

relations: GraveStone remains the only active grave owner
Giant Torii and Distant Horizons use the same exact versions on every required side
The recruit cap is not written to Client/ManagedPack/defaultconfigs
VanillaBackport owns the overlapping Copper Age and spear backports while Trials remains installed
Platform 1.4.2 satisfies VanillaBackport 1.2.2 and remains inside Rotten Creatures' open dependency range
Tiny Takeover uses vanilla entity types and swaps only its baby model during render, so Fresh Animations has no unsupported Tiny Takeover entity IDs
JEM Settlements is the single family authority. Settlement membership consumes its home penalties but does not define different family rules
Recruits workstation conversion and promotion replace entity bodies while retaining one persistent family person ID and provenance
Xaero receives only a temporary native camera destination and no waypoint mutation
notes: Sirok gains 15 blocks on each X and Z side for 30 blocks more total width per horizontal axis
Guard-specific quest hooks are removed with Guard Villagers
Inventory Tabs is restored with its loaded-chunk-only JEM patch and client configuration
The title screen enforces logical GUI scale 4 without changing the saved in-game GUI option
VillagerMakeLove is disabled. One bounded JEM engine handles Villager and Recruits courtship and birth with native food or hunger inputs
Each person owns an upward 3x3x3 zone. Spouse beds may be separate or adjacent, and home resource assignments remain unique
The first local server start exposed Platform 1.3.4 as the earliest invalid dependency state. The managed client and server now use the same Platform 1.4.2 artifact
No MineRENT, stable profile or release baseline mutation is part of this branch
unresolved: Nullscape and Trek both define minecraft:end_cities, so data-pack order still selects one owner
Gameplay and visual acceptance require the user's Test JEM session
The MineRENT recruit cap is pending a later approved production deployment
